A '''pirate base''' located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] served as the headquarters of the [[Sand slum pirates]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:PirateBaseTatooine3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An Imperial banner on the wall of the base's interior]]
The pirate base was located east of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the planet Tatooine. Occupied by a band of criminals known as the [[Sand slum pirates]] and their [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leader, the base consisted of several underground levels,<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> with its interior resembling the design of [[Imperial Tactical Center]]s.<ref>{{SonyCite|url=manual_detail.jsp?chapter=16|text=Galactic Civil War}}</ref> Indeed, the interior of the base consisted of at least a couple banners emblazoned with the [[Imperial crest/Legends|crest]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], indicating that the base was once under the control of Imperial forces.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==History==
{{Quote|Somewhere on this deserty planet, strife between ranchers and pirates rages on. Seek them out, choose the correct path, and the Mark of Honor shall be bestowed upon you.|[[Unidentified Rodian hermit|The hermit]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
[[File:PirateBaseTatooine2.jpg|200px|thumb|The bottom-most level of the base consisted of a Krayt Dragon skull affixed on the wall.]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the pirates harassed the farmers [[Roric Goldenfield|Roric]] and [[Helen Goldenfield]] who lived in the neighboring [[The Ranch|ranch]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Hero of Tatooine|spacer]] pinned down and [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|attacked]] the pirate leader at the bottom-most level of the base. However, the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] spared the pirate's life after he surrendered. For the spacer's part in diffusing tensions between the pirates and the local [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]], the spacer was awarded with the [[Mark of Honor]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pirate base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The sand slum pirates and their base were added to the game as part of the revamped version of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Players taking part in the "Honor" portion of the "Hero of Tatooine" had to fight the sand slum pirates in their base and defeat their leader.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> This version of the quest was significantly easier than the original in which players had to find and defeat a generic "pirate leader" who spawned at random location across Tatooine.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> However, upon release of the "Publish 25", several bugs affected the new pirate leader and it was impossible to compete the quest until the publication of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2.7|Chapter 2.7]]" update, on [[September 6]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
